welcome.title: Welcome to SingTube!
welcome.description: Let's take a quick tour of your AI-powered karaoke stage. We'll show you the key features to get you singing in no time!

search.title: Search for Songs
search.description: Enter song titles or artist names in any language. Press Enter or click the search button to find karaoke tracks on YouTube. Try '周杰伦' or 'Jay Chou'!

aiButton.title: AI Recommendations
aiButton.description: Get personalized song suggestions! Click the AI button to discover new karaoke tracks based on your search history and preferences.

howToJoin.title: Share & Join Rooms
howToJoin.description: Create a collaborative karaoke room! Click the Share button in your queue to invite friends. They can join and add songs to the shared queue in real-time.

playButton.title: Playback Controls
playButton.description: Control your karaoke session with play/pause, skip forward, or go back buttons. Double-click any song in your queue to jump to it instantly.

searchResults.title: Search Results
searchResults.description: Browse your search results here! Click 'Add' to add songs to your queue. Preview any song before adding it to see if it's the right version.

queue.title: Your KTV Room
queue.description: Your song queue! Drag to reorder songs, click the X to remove them. Save, load, or share your queue using the buttons at the top.

complete.title: You're All Set!
complete.description: That's it! Start searching for songs, let AI help you discover new tracks, and sing your heart out. Have fun! 🎤

recommendations.title: AI Song Recommendations
recommendations.description: Get personalized karaoke song recommendations powered by AI
